## Summary

Describe what this PR changes.

## Checklist

- [ ] Root README entries use `- [Name](link) - Description.` format.
- [ ] New root README entries are high-signal resources we can recommend.
- [ ] Broad or speculative candidates are placed in `docs/`, not the root README.
- [ ] Benchmark entries are treated as evaluation substrates, not as research directions.
- [ ] Links point to canonical paper, project, conference, or repository pages.
- [ ] Descriptions are factual, short, and end with a period.
- [ ] `npx --yes awesome-lint README.md` passes, or failures are explained.
